property_summary: For all callers, calling sudicideAnyone() succeeds (does not revert) iff the caller is the contract's owner; the reference requires caller==owner so only the owner can successfully call it, while the mutant inverts the check allowing non-owners and causing owner calls to revert.
change_summary: Negate the require condition so only non-owners can call sudicideAnyone, altering who can trigger selfdestruct.
